content.en_us:
An advanced oil processing machine available after doing [[vacuum oil processing|Vacuum Oil Processing]]. Allows earlier tier oils to be processed into desulfurized variants, which can be turned into vacuum oil products while using a [[standard refinery|Oil Refinery]]. Recipes require [[liquid hydrogen|Liquid Hydrogen]] which is [[compressed|Compressor]] to 1 PU, while yielding [[sour gas|Sour Gas]] as a byproduct.

Requires a catalytic converter to operate, which is made from either [[bismuth|Bismuth]] or [[arsenic|Arsenic]].
